note: Pike County IL publishes parcels only through its WTH Think GIS web viewer (pikeil.wthgis.com). No ArcGIS REST services directory or parcel layer was found: probes of pikeil.wthgis.com /arcgis/rest/services, /rest/services and /arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/MapServer returned 404; ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Pike County parcels found nothing county-published; the county site lists no download or API link. Parcel data appears only from commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Rockford Map, Acres) or a third-party portal.
